## Summary

One or two English sentences: what this change does and why.

## Changes

- Bullet list of the user-visible or operational changes, in English.
- Reference the issues this closes (`Closes #123`).

## Release checklist

Fill this in only for `dev → main` and `hotfix/* → main` release PRs. Ordinary
feature and fix PRs land in `dev` and skip it.

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`: the `[Unreleased]` entries are moved under a new
      `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` heading (Keep a Changelog groups, English
      entries, semantic version).
- [ ] `## Resumen (ES)` below is filled with the neutral Spanish summary.
